title: Local perfect lifting from a lisse residue complex without finite coefficient hypotheses
statement:
Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], meaning that it has a finite affine open cover by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring, $J\subseteq A$ an ideal, and assume $A\xrightarrow{\sim}\varprojlim_{n\geq1}A/J^n$ [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]. On the small pro-étale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] put $B_X=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}\underline{A/J^n}$, using constant sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Use module sheaves and derived categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and let $M\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(B_X))$ be locally derived $JB_X$-complete [def-weil-pbc-locally-derived-ringed-ideal-complete]. Suppose $M\otimes^L_{B_X}\underline{A/J}\simeq
u_X^*C$, where $
u_X$ is the étale/pro-étale comparison [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and $C$ is a bounded étale $A/J$-complex. Assume each $H^q(C)$ is étale locally constant with finitely generated $A/J$-module values [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], and that there are integers $a\leq b$ with $H^q(C\otimes^L_{\underline{A/J}}N)=0$ for every degree-zero étale $A/J$-module sheaf $N$ and every $q
otin[a,b]$. Derived tensors are [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Then there is a pro-étale covering $\{U_t	o X\}$ and, for each $t$, a bounded complex $P_t^ ullet$ of finite projective $A$-modules [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex] such that $M|_{U_t}\simeq (B_X|_{U_t})\otimes_A P_t^ ullet$. The last expression is termwise extension of the constant complex. Neither $A/J$ nor $A/J^n$ is required to be finite as a set or perfect over $A$.
